newsitem.title: USA: Int'l CableTel buys rest of English Cable.
newsitem.headline: Int'l CableTel buys rest of English Cable.

text.p: International CableTel Inc said on Tuesday it acquired the 30 percent of English Cable Enterprises Inc the company did not previously own.
CableTel said it exchanged 1.415 million shares of its common stock for the remaining interest in ECE held by its minority partners.
Of those shares, 25 percent are eligible for sale starting March 4, 1997, with the remaining shares being eligible for sale on Sept. 4, 1998, the company said.
CableTel shares fell 1/8 to 24-1/8 in Nasdaq trading Tueday.

CableTel said it has about 32 million shares of common stock outstanding. About 21.9 million shares are reserved for issuance upon the exercise of options, warrants and the conversion of convertible securities.
ECE owns and operates four telecommunications and cable television franchises in the northern suburbs of London, the company said.
